findings_qualitative.value: ALMA CO isotopologues, H2CO and CH3OH show NE redshifted and SW blueshifted emission consistent with the [O III]-implied axis; red lobe wide-angle (~100-110 deg)

evidence.quote: We estimate a $\sim100^\circ-110^\circ$ for the edge-to-edge outflow opening angle of the red-shifted lobe.

claims.hypothesis: Do [O III] and [O I] trace a bipolar wide-angle outflow from G11.94?
claims.experiment: Blue/red-shifted maps of FIFI-LS lines compared with ALMA molecular tracers
claims.result: Velocity gradient NE-SW; ALMA tracers show same axis
claims.finding: Outflow with red lobe NE and blue lobe SW, PA ~ -143 deg

evidence.quote: We infer a position angle for the blue-shifted lobe of approximately $-143\degree$.

claims.hypothesis: Is the ionized outflow the primary disk wind while molecular gas is swept up?
claims.experiment: Mass and momentum fluxes for ionized, atomic and molecular components
claims.result: Ionized mass flux ~10% of accretion rate; molecular dominates mass flux
claims.finding: Ionized outflow is primary; molecular is secondary swept-up

evidence.quote: the molecular outflow dominates the total mass flux, suggesting it is mainly composed of swept-up, secondary outflow gas.

why_this_data.value: Archival ALMA data used to investigate the nature of the FIFI-LS emission

evidence.quote: to investigate the nature of the emission lines detected in our FIFI-LS observations

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: NW-SE outflow scenario disfavored in favor of NE-SW

evidence.quote: there are several reasons why we favor the outflow in the NE-SW direction instead of this scenario.

limitations_admitted.value: Molecular emission contaminated by nearby protostars; Tex choice gives minimum mass

evidence.quote: The molecular emission from these protostars contaminates the analysis of the outflow morphology from G11.94

referee_caveats_inferred: Outflow rates rely on assumed filling factor, extinction and 3D velocity equal to line-of-sight velocity
Single Tex and optically thin CO assumption
Low FIFI-LS spectral resolution limits kinematics
